change.description: Publish wm-a-v5 and wm-b-v5 with a compact A watermark canvas after the production wm-a-v4 card rendition was verified oversized, while preserving v1/v2/v3/v4 watermark URLs and historical snapshot semantics.
change.release_unit_description: static frontend and full-feature Docker image

planned.reasoning: The candidate adds compatible public media render identities and a compact watermark canvas. Existing v1/v2/v3/v4 identities remain available for old snapshots and no persistence schema changes are introduced.

evidence.command: Public media SPEC records the v5 identity, compact A canvas, and legacy compatibility contract
ADR records the current v5 rendition boundary and compact A canvas

current.reasoning: New public and admin URLs default to v5, v5 keeps the finite A/B contract and explicit h_ratio=100, and v1/v2/v3/v4 paths remain readable without rewriting historical bytes.

evidence.command: Versioned Imagor filters use explicit width and h_ratio=100 bounds while v5 uses the compact A canvas
Static packaging closes current v5 A/B siblings and preserves explicit v3/v4 and legacy migration behavior

scope_drift.description: The candidate remains limited to public media rendering, versioned static assets, static packaging, tests, and their owning documentation; no persistence, authorization, or playback contract changed.

verified.reasoning: Focused public-media tests pass with 210 passed and 3 skipped, the full repository check passes with only pre-existing warnings and infos, and the v5 assets are validated as compact zero-origin SVGs.

evidence.command: bun test src/server/public-media-watermark-assets.test.ts: v5 light/dark assets and compact viewBox pass
bun run check: Biome check and Admin UI boundary check pass; existing warnings and infos are non-fatal
bun test src/lib/__tests__/public-media.test.ts: v5 defaults, complete v5 A/B candidates, and explicit v1/v2/v3/v4 compatibility pass
bun test src/server/http-compat-api.test.ts: current v5 URLs and explicit legacy candidates pass

persistent_state.state_description: No SQLite schema, local content format, browser persistence, or durable release-ledger state changes; v5 candidates are regenerated from public snapshots and static artifacts.

evidence.command: HTTP compatibility coverage exercises versioned media paths without a state migration
